The Century of Humiliation

Four crises. Three rulers. One empire in decline.

Between 1839 and 1901, the Qing Empire — for centuries the dominant power of East Asia — suffered a series of military defeats, unequal treaties, and internal rebellions that Chinese historians came to call the "Century of Humiliation." In each chapter below, you will sit on the Dragon Throne at a different moment of crisis and make the decisions the emperor actually faced. Choose carefully: history will still have the final word.
